title: Core: AS2 for loop and while loop compilation
description: Verify AS2 loop constructs compile correctly: for (var i=0; i<10; i++), while (cond), do {} while (cond), break, continue, labeled break. Verify ActionIf (0x9D) and ActionJump (0x99) opcodes. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/loops.test.ts.
